tableNote: ctdlHub-101926 P6 (WORKORDER-P6 rules): THE ONE LOCATOR TABLE of the CTDL family. Every crossRef locator a CTDL-family forge records is in exactly one of the two lists. A STRUCTURE locator relates two family terms structurally and is written by the family-structure producer (ctdlFamilyStructure) as the July edge types; a CORRESPONDENCE locator is a published cross-IRI assertion and is written by a declared bridge as DECLARED_CORRESPONDENCE with the predicate verbatim (never a match edge, R6). A locator in neither list is refused by name by every reader of this table. rdfs:subClassOf across standards is STRUCTURE (it is in the July oracle's 506 family edges); rdfs:subPropertyOf is CORRESPONDENCE. meta:domainFor is structure (the class side of schema:domainIncludes): measured 2026-10-21, it adds no family edge the domainIncludes reading does not already make.
